headline: Ramesh Arvind climbs 614 places on ARC-2

sections.text: Ramesh Arvind rose from 651st to 37th, climbing 614 places to 34.44 after a 3.75-point gain.
Arvind now sits 37th on the public board after beginning the day outside the top 500.
